guide.description: A spinning soccer-pattern mirror ball of 32 facets: every facet that lights up plays its own note, in time.

sections.title: Audio
sections.text: Mono output. Notes come from tile height: tiles near the top play higher. In the Euro groove a gong rings in every fourth bar. Sparkles keep sample-accurate time on the audio thread. Route sound and set its level in Menu. In Preview, enable Listen to preview first.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: Tempo, rate, density, scale, colors, energy, drive, voice, groove and the acid layer save automatically. Reopening keeps them and starts stopped.
